P02.name: Catch and store energy
P02.purpose: Retain useful surplus flows before they dissipate.

P03.name: Obtain a yield
P03.purpose: Define and measure durable useful output.

P04.name: Apply self-regulation and accept feedback
P04.purpose: Keep the system within safe and intended bounds.

P05.name: Use and value renewable resources and services
P05.purpose: Prefer renewable, local, repairable, regenerative inputs where justified.

P06.name: Produce no waste
P06.purpose: Treat avoidable losses and byproducts as candidate inputs.

P07.name: Design from patterns to details
P07.purpose: Establish system boundary, flows, dependencies, and constraints before detail expansion.

P08.name: Integrate rather than segregate
P08.purpose: Connect compatible nodes when transfer value exceeds total connection burden.

P09.name: Use small and slow solutions
P09.purpose: Match intervention scale to evidence, reversibility, and risk.

P10.name: Use and value diversity
P10.purpose: Reduce single points of failure and increase adaptive capacity.

P11.name: Use edges and value the marginal
P11.purpose: Inspect interfaces, overlooked users, boundary losses, and low-resource opportunities.

P12.name: Creatively use and respond to change
P12.purpose: Adapt assumptions and plans to meaningful changes in conditions.

context.description: Initial L0/L1 intake context. It records a hypothesis and routing state only. It is not a physical test plan, performance claim, prototype certification, or physical-system validation record.
context.evidence_label: L1 — documented source, calculation, simulation, or design rationale
context.name: OpenRoot Thermal Cascade L0/L1 intake

gates.message: Risk level 2 exceeds evidence level 1. Reduce scope, gather evidence, or require explicit human review.
Safety review is incomplete for a risk level of 2 or greater. Do not execute or scale a physical intervention.
Measurements are missing while intervention scale exceeds a minimal pilot. Observe and measure before expanding.
Safe stop conditions are not defined for a nonzero risk context. Define stop conditions before testing.
Feedback, bounds, or stop conditions are incomplete. Add monitoring before any action beyond observation.

invariants: Evidence level may not be promoted by this router.
CI validation does not establish physical performance or safety.
L0/L1 contexts must not be presented as documented physical validation.
High-risk or irreversible actions require explicit human review.
Runtime state must not be automatically committed or released.

recommended_actions.action: Collect the smallest set of measurements that removes the highest-impact uncertainty.
recommended_actions.artifact: Dated raw-data record with conditions, instrument, units, and caveats.

recommended_actions.action: Draw or update the system boundary: inputs, outputs, nodes, flows, dependencies, hazards, and excluded claims.
recommended_actions.artifact: System map or boundary diagram linked from the design packet.

recommended_actions.action: Define measurable operating bounds, feedback metrics, safe stop conditions, and human escalation criteria.
recommended_actions.artifact: Test protocol with explicit stop conditions and review requirements.

recommended_actions.action: Reduce the intervention to a reversible, single-node, low-risk pilot that is proportionate to the evidence level.
recommended_actions.artifact: Pilot plan, rollback plan, and expected evidence artifact.

recommended_actions.action: Map the surplus or waste stream, quantify it, and test one safe route for capture, storage, or reuse.
recommended_actions.artifact: Flow estimate with source, sink, transfer loss, and storage limits.

recommended_actions.action: Evaluate whether one node output can become another node input without increasing maintenance or risk disproportionately.
recommended_actions.artifact: Node-to-node interface specification and compatibility check.

recommended_actions.action: Compare renewable, local, repairable, and regenerative alternatives against lifecycle burden and reliability.
recommended_actions.artifact: Option comparison with maintenance, cost, repairability, and dependency notes.

recommended_actions.action: Inspect interfaces, boundary losses, neglected users, low-resource nodes, and underused surplus streams.
recommended_actions.artifact: Edge-opportunity inventory ranked by benefit, effort, and risk.
